name: Promising Future
texts: Each player looks at the top 5 cards of their Main Deck, chooses one, then recycles the rest. Starting with the next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs.
manual: Each player looks at the top 5 cards of their Main Deck, chooses one, then recycles the rest.
Starting with the next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs.
